phase_note: PRE_START means combat_start after initial auras and before Start of Combat text. Human review logs and POST_FIGHT mean GameLog.record_round's post-fight live RecruitUnit board: away Birds and their Eggs are absent, temporary combat layers may differ, and combat carry is applied. Only POST_FIGHT bot rows share the human recording phase; human examples are two selected wins, not a sample.

plan.pairing: Same predeclared eligible seeds and seats in two separate arms; divergent actions consume shops/pools differently, so not matched shop luck.

plan.scope_note: The aggressive arm changes only the flight decision inside the existing committed bot turn: largest legal flier at the first flight decision each turn, bypassing danger/score/home-minimum/from-round/omen/allowlist gates for that carry only. Subsequent flight decisions use the native policy. It obeys HeldUnits.flies, pending-choice restrictions and native RecruitRules.sell, trips, return guards, pool purchases, heroes, fights, damage and eliminations. The forced carry leaves its native Egg, where applicable; other flights retain native policy guards. All shop, economy and placement policies remain native. This probes one skilled decision, not optimal human play. No runaway cutoff or gameplay pass/fail bar is defined.
plan.stopping: Run native games to completion; observe through R16. No forced continuation, sample extension, tuning, or new gameplay threshold.
